findings.entity: skateboard during first trick (and skater airborne phase)
findings.description: After the feet leave the deck at ~01:50-01:75, the board hangs in mid-air below and apart from the rider's feet for roughly a full second (01:75-02:75) at nearly constant height and only slowly rotating, with no foot contact guiding it, while the tucked rider also remains aloft; total airtime from pop (~01:40) to re-contact (~03:00-03:25) is ~1.6 s, far longer than gravity allows for an ollie of this height, so the board and rider float without support.
